audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads EVEN at 6/10 on a 63.48% win rate, and the chart hands Shen five stages to Swain's zero — including the 2+ items row, which this page's own whys[6] and spikes[3] say Swain wins.
audit.why: 63.48% is one of the strongest lanes on the champion. The two rows where the chart directly contradicts the adjacent prose are Level 6 (whys[4]: 'you own the 1v1 drain') and 2+ items (whys[6]: 'two-item Swain wins the attrition war that Shen tried to win all lane'). Those are the rows I flipped; I left Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and first item with Shen because the text there is a genuine argument, not a template.
audit.corrected: diff FAVOURED at 4/10; Level 6 and 2+ items flipped to Swain in both layers with ratings raised.

audit.why: The spike ladder is real and specific: Shen's level 2-3 W window, Stand United at 6, his Iceborn Gauntlet item spike, and Swain's two-item attrition takeover. Nothing fabricated, nothing missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit's Refuge is described as blanking 'the auto-weave' but the page never states the limit of what it blocks.
audit.why: Riot's text is precise: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' It stops attacks, not abilities — Death's Hand, Vision of Empire and Nevermove all land through it. That converts a scary zone into a simple instruction: stop auto-attacking inside 400 and keep casting. Without it, a Swain player disengages entirely from a window he can still deal damage in.
audit.corrected: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only; your spells pass through. Stop autoing inside 400, keep casting, and root him while it is on its 16s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ki Barrier is never mentioned, and it is the reason burst windows fail here.
audit.why: The _missing-interactions entry for this matchup flags exactly this: 'Shen's Ki Barrier (P), Stand United (R) absorbs your burst window — force it out before you commit.' Ki Barrier shields Shen after every spell cast, with its cooldown reduced by affecting champions, so a Shen who has just cast anything is shielded when your combo lands.
audit.corrected: Shen re-shields off any cast — bait a spell, let Ki Barrier pop, and commit into the gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shadow Dash is called 'His engage CC. Dodge it.' with no range and no cooldown, in three places.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 600 range on 18/16/14/12/10 and costs 150 energy. An 18-second rank-1 cooldown against a 12-second Nevermove is the entire trading rhythm of the lane, and the page is built around tracking it.
audit.corrected: 600-range taunt, down 18s at rank 1 — that is the trade window.

audit.why: The packet's suspectName hit on 'Use Vision of Empire' in content.mid is a false positive — Vision of Empire is Swain's real W name, flagged only by edit distance against the lowercased string. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion.
